perf.summary: Branchless update of best/alpha (and best/beta) to shorten the dependency chain in the move loop.
perf.currentCost: `if (val > best) best = val; if (best > alpha) alpha = best;` are two dependent conditional branches per move. In alpha-beta these branches are data-dependent and often mispredict, stalling the search.
perf.proposedChange: Use branchless max/min: `best = math.max(best, val); alpha = math.max(alpha, best);` in Maximize and `best = math.min(best, val); beta = math.min(beta, best);` in Minimize. Keep the `if (beta <= alpha) break;` cutoff branch (it must remain a branch for early exit).
perf.rationale: math.max/min on long lower to a compare+cmov (or SSE/NEON min/max), removing two mispredictable branches per iteration and shortening the latency of the best/alpha update chain that gates the cutoff test.
perf.risk: Semantics identical: max/min reproduce the exact assignments. Only the cutoff `beta <= alpha` stays branchy (required for correctness of pruning). No overflow concern — values are bounded game evaluations, and long.MinValue/MaxValue seeds compare correctly with cmov.
